name: Andrey
text: Had a great stay. Cabin is absolutely wonderful and cozy. Would be happy to return. Hosts are helpful and instructions are clear - 10/10

name: Polina
text: Amazing place! Will definitely come back later.

name: Ethan
text: We had a great stay!! This was my first ever time staying here and Craig made it a great first experience!! Will definitely plan a return visit in the future

name: Michael
text: The cabin was very beautiful. my girlfriend enjoyed the view and the fresh breeze. having morning coffee at the patio with a great view was a great experience. I really recommend checking them out.

name: Shannon
text: Great place! Perfect for a couple or small family

name: Jennifer
text: Had everything needed. The deck was the best part of this house! Close to amenities.

name: Ryan
text: The home was lovely, very peaceful, quiet, and close to the shops and restaurants. Craig were so communicative and prompt. It really felt like they went the extra mile, especially adding in a list of things to do and foods to try at Big Bear. Overall a great experience and would definitely use their services again!

name: Mariana
text: Me and my friends loved this place! The cabin was clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The host was very welcoming and made communication super easy, which made check-in and check-out smooth. The location was perfect close to everything we needed but still quiet enough to relax. We really appreciated the thoughtful touches and would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

name: Priya
text: Great place. Friendly host and very responsive. The house itself has a cozy vibes. We enjoyed our stay!! Thank you Craig!!

name: Daniel
text: The place was very clean and it was in a beautiful location. This place is not very far from the shopping center.

name: Nathaniel
text: Great place! Easy to walk to the local busses if you don’t want to drive!

name: Johannes
text: Great cabin to enjoy the nature while sitting outside on the terrace. Equipped with everything you need to supply yourself. Would definitely come back!

name: Vanessa
text: Craig home was the perfect spot for my parents and I have to have a fun and relaxing getaway. The house was the perfect size for us 3 and had everything we needed. The area and neighborhood were quiet and very peaceful. Amazing views! They were so responsive and helpful with questions we had and were checking in with us during our stay which I appreciated. Would definitely recommend to anyone staying in Big Bear.

name: Jennifer
text: Such a cute cozy cabin. Very clean and well stocked with everything we needed. Great kitchen with new appliances. Fast WiFi. Check in was super easy. The deck space was great and had a spectacular view.

name: Tahmeka
text: Our stay was great! Nice view points, very cozy & plenty of space for 2 people. Everything was super close by, even the lake. Craig respond quickly whenever we had a questions or needed suggestions. I definitely see us coming back to stay again.

name: Chris
text: This magnificent cabin was an amazing and beautiful place for a romantic birthday getaway. The host was very helpful. I definitely recommend it.

name: Alyssa
text: Staying here was such a pleasure! Working fulltime with three kids is hard and this place gave me such a blessed amount of relaxation. It snowed that was such a great bonus. Definitely would rebook!

name: Diana
text: My family and I had such an amazing time in this cabin! I highly recommended this hidden gem to other families looking for a convinient and a comfortable place to relax. We can call this place our home away from home and Craig's responsiveness was top notch and friendly. We look forward to reserving this home again in the summer!! Amazing hosts!

name: Hailey
text: Such a cute and cozy get away! Hosts responded very quickly to any questions and the cabin was so close to everywhere you would want to go. Great stay!

name: Christy
text: Our stay was great! Cozy, cute little cabin, exactly as advertised (except that the post said dryer is in building, but it’s actually in the home, which was a great surprise!). No firewood for the fire, so if you want to have a fire grab some in advance. They did provide fire starter. Parking space was flat which is nice for snowy conditions. Location is great, easy to find and close to the mountain. It was perfect for our use, would definitely go back!

name: Alyssa
text: It was really nice a little smaller then I thought but it was super cute and I would definitely stay here again

name: Fernandou
text: Thank you for everything. It's very nice customer service.

name: Scott
text: Great proximity to the slopes! It was a perfect stay and met our expectations. Craig were responsive hosts and made it quick and easy to check-in after a long day of traveling and skiing.

name: Frank
text: Very cozy place my wife and kids loved it. Thank you for having us.

name: Jose
text: Everything was beautiful cozy and organized.

name: Jesus
text: Excelent

name: Liliana
text: Such a lovely place! Great location, very close to the slopes, village and lake. The cabin is warm and welcoming, has everything you need and more, we had a great time in it too playing loteria at night :) everything about it is very convenient such as the parking lot, the wash and dryer, the dishwasher, all of it really, including the way to access to it and the distribution of the whole cabin. The communication with the hosts was on point. We will definitely come back in the future!

name: Elliot
text: Good place to stay

name: Kevin
text: Great location and great stay!

name: Jesus

name: Tal
text: We thoroughly enjoyed our stay in the cabin! All the facilities were in excellent working order and spotlessly clean. Thank you!

name: Mohammad Suha
text: Everything was the way that we expected!

name: Hovig
text: Very nice house everything was as described, the balcony was very nice lots of chairs and tables made making dinner very convenient, everything was less than a 10 minute drive away and Ubers were easily attainable no matter the time. One thing to note if you are over 6 foot you should call dibs on the downstairs bedroom. Overall great stay and well worth the price.

name: Peter
text: Fantastic Stay. Two thumbs up. It is so quiet and I was able to really get some deep work done.

name: Julianna
text: This place exceeded my expectations everything about it was perfect for us😊Will for sure be returning to this place for another vacation 😁Great hosts as well very kind!

name: Lori
text: Peaceful stay in a great location. The deck provides a great place to relax and a surprising amount of privacy in a neighborhood. We enjoyed exploring the area and went on a nearby hike.  Craig were friendly and helpful.

name: Moises
text: Everything was as advertised. Great communication.

name: David
text: Beautiful, amazing place to stay! Very well organized and laid out. Host was very responsive and friendly. This is far and above the best air bnb I’ve had the pleasure of staying at. I highly recommend this place!

name: Iván
text: A good place to stay, quiet and comfortable, I went with my wife and 2 year old daughter, the kitchen, the fret and spices that have a lot of ease not to buy too many things, the cafes they provide is a plus to enjoy a cold morning. Overall a very cozy and quiet place. Thanks for having us 😁

name: Richard
text: On of the most amazing stays I’ve had. Great location super comfy and beautiful scenery. Would def recommend and or stay again if I’m back in the area in the future. Great host and location was clean and smelled amazing upon entering.

name: Annet
text: The Cabin went beyond our expectations, it was super cozy and my family loved the place! Would most definitely go back again!

name: Tumur
text: A lovely place to relax! The apartment was even better than in the photos — clean, cozy and very stylishly decorated. The bed is comfortable and the kitchen has all the essentials for cooking. I especially liked the view and proximity to the main attractions. The host was very hospitable and was always in touch, answered all questions quickly. I recommend this place for those looking for comfort and convenient location!”

name: Justyne
text: We really enjoyed our stay at the house! We drove down to the zoo one of the days and were able to take the trolley right into town for lunch, super nice to not have to drive much. The house is cozy and perfect for board games or watching shows as the wifi runs very fast.

name: Austin
text: Was a great time, everything was in good order when we arrived, and the location was great, not too far from the main attractions of Big Bear, but still private enough. Had all the amenities that we needed, and the back deck was great for enjoying the scenery.

name: Alejandra
text: Amazing place! Super beautiful, fully equipped... you don't need to bring anything but your personal things, you will find everything you need in the cabin. I will definitely come back and highly recommend it.

name: William
text: Really enjoyed my self. This cabin was the perfect location to be in. I’ll definitely be back!

name: Ethan
text: Clean and in a very nice neighborhood.

name: Daniel
text: Everything about Craig's place was phenomenal! Definitely recommend their home. Craig has one of best customer service I have had so far while using short term rentals. Their home is very cosy, clean, and less than 10 minutes away from your local grocery stores and about 15 minutes from The Village. Highly recommend!!!

name: Kylea-Rose
text: Wonderful place. Peaceful and yet close to town. Hosts had extremely good communication. Will definitely stay again next time we are in Big Bear! Thank you for having us!

name: Michael Angelo
text: Such a beautiful stay whether it be with a significant other or small family. My partner and I enjoyed the peaceful atmosphere and our quality time together while taking advantage of nearby activities! I’d book this place again :)

name: Anthony
text: We had an amazing time in this cozy cabin. We will defanitly be back again.

name: Alvin
text: Great and responsive host! Very nice view from the deck, and we like how squeaky clean the floor was since we do not wear shoes inside the house.

name: Laszlo
text: We had an amazing getaway with my family of 6. The house is clean, the view is beautiful. Location is great. Highly recommend

name: Ashley
text: We had a great stay at Craig’s house. We had one small hiccup when we arrived but Craig was so responsive and corrected it right away! He was on top of things and sent local recommendations which was so nice. The house was comfortable and well equipped with what we needed. The neighborhood was very peaceful and an easy drive to everything.

name: Liliana
text: No complaints. Beautiful views, great location, really clean. Satisfied for sure.

name: Bobbi
text: Great location. Much needed quite get away!

name: Eveaunna
text: I rented Craig’s cabin twice and both times were so worth it.  It was the most peaceful I’ve felt in so long. You can go out to the patio early morning and watch and hear all the birds soaring through the trees. The neighborhood is quiet, parking is right next to the door/walkway. Craig is so good with giving local recommendations and super great with responding fast for any questions. I will always look for their cabin first if I want to vacation in big bear. Thank you Craig!

name: Vanessa
text: Comfortable and beautiful deck to enjoy a morning coffee. Location is great!

name: Luke
text: Really enjoyed our stay. Thanks

name: John

name: Jake
text: This was a perfect getaway for the vacation that we needed. Craig has an excellent cabin that I’d certainly recommend!

name: Jade
text: Beautiful place, me and my friends had a blast, and they accommodated us on short notice! perfect place to hang with friends and explore, plus amazing views. it’s like a big tree house

name: Michael
text: Amazing place for a getaway🙌🏽

name: Joshua
text: Craig was very nice and helpful.  The cabin was beautiful and clean. The view of the cabin was wonderful. We look forward to stay in here again!

name: Jan
text: Craig’s place was nice. Takes about 7-10 minutes to get to the Village and other places. Very quiet at night. Good for a family of 4.  The family and I needed an escape and we got what we wanted.  Very responsive hosts.

name: Zilan
text: We really enjoyed our stay. We stayed during a winter storm. Craig was extremely helpful accomendating our needs.

name: Alexander
text: Cabin is clean, cozy and well equipped with everything that is needed. Perfect for our small family and near the zoo and village. We had a relaxing time at their cabin and it was very peaceful. Thank you for a great stay!

name: André
text: Lovely cabin! Wonderfully gracious hosts who respond and accommodate over messaging in minutes.

name: Romelia
text: we absolutely loved the cabin it was beautiful and very peaceful would definitely book again.

name: Joshua
text: Place was awesome to get away with the family and enjoy the outdoors and relax

name: Ricardo
text: Craig is such a great host.  Super quick to respond and extremely helpful with any questions we had.  It was clear they care about the guest experience and the place was perfect for kids and adults alike.  One special bonus that I have to mention for those potential renters with kids that love sledding is that the property sits on a hill that makes for epic sledding right on the property.  Great fireplace and comfortable temperature regulation with the nest thermostat.  I often find big bear homes to be hit and miss when it comes to being too cold or too hot but this place was great.  It’s a great home but for sure what earned the 5 stars was Craig being such a warm and helpful host.  Would stay again in a heartbeat.

name: Margaretha
text: Great Place

name: Natalia
text: This cabin exceeded expectations, equipped with everything we needed. The host's attention to detail made our stay seamless, from easy check-in to thoughtful local recommendations. The cozy ambiance and scenic surroundings made it a memorable retreat. Very happy that we came here and even weather was so nice – highly recommend! Thank you!

name: Allegra
text: Perfect cozy getaway for us! Super responsive hosts. Loved curling up by the fire to relax in the evenings.

name: Benjamin
text: nice and cozy place

name: Thalia
text: I'm very happy with all the service, the instructions were clear, answer and clarify all of your questions. I feel very satisfied with the cleanliness. An excellent place that I would definitely book again. Thank you for everything…

name: Treishawn
text: Gorgeous place and the hospitality was outstanding! Highly recommend coming to this spot if you ever wanna check out big bear! Perfect little weekend getaway!

name: Sami
text: We loved to stay at the cabin of Craig in our first time in Big Bear! Adorable experience!

name: Franky

name: Arianna
text: Staying at Craig’s was our best decision. The cabin is lovely, comfortable, clean and close to the main bulevar. Also, it has all the things you need to have great weekend with your family and friends. Craig was friendly and attentive during our whole stay, I strongly suggest staying with them if you want to have a great getaway weekend.

name: Cindy
text: Loved this place! Really enjoyed the deck ❤️ super peaceful

name: Linda
text: Great hosts. Very available and responsive. Property was perfect. Cabin was lacking nothing. Couldn't ask for anything more. Would happily stay there again and again!

name: Michelle
text: What a lovely cabin! My boyfriend and I do little getaways every few months, and he told me this is the best airbnb we’ve booked so far! The view is amazing, the whole place was clean and spacious. We didn’t find any olive oil to cook pasta with, and Craig sent us 2 bottles of olive oil right away, it was on the porch in less than 30min. Super responsive hosts. Location was also pristine. Only 10min drive to all the shops and trails. The only thing is some of the cooking utensils and pans are not in the best condition. But this is me being nitpicky. We really wanted to stay another night because of how cozy it was! Would stay again.

name: Isaac
text: Awesome place to go and relax

name: Rubi
text: It was an Amazing, Most beautiful Views & Cabin. Would definitely come back. Very Peaceful. The host are Awesome.

name: Gabriel

name: Elsie
text: Loved our stay! We wanted to visit the area for my dad’s birthday and absolutely loved this place! So clean, peaceful, and calm. Thank you!

name: Jose
text: Really enjoyed the place it was worth the stay. Craig was really attentive and fast to respond back if I had questions. Definitely would recommend this place.

name: Melanie
text: Very cute cabin, felt very cozy. I loved sitting on the deck while seeing the stars at night. Craig responded to me right away with my questions and were very helpful. Would definitely come back here!

name: Otto

name: Miles
text: Great and accurate listing!

name: Jose Luis
text: Its was a great place to be, we were please with the place

name: Laura
text: The cabin is beautiful and the view from the deck felt like you were standing in the tree tops.

name: Danielle
text: Cozy & at home feel cabin ! Great location, close to grocery stores, fast food & restaurants, and by the lake. Quiet and peaceful neighborhood.

name: Richard
text: It was a delight staying at this cabin. The balcony view is breathtaking and the cabin has all amenities listed. Craig did an excellent job ensuring that our stay was good and responded to all our needs. Overall a wonderful experience.

name: Valente
text: Cozy place with a view. Perfect get away home that feels like HOME! Everything needed is there and the host are very helpful. I’m definitely saving this place for another trip.

name: Valerie
text: Honestly the house was so beautiful and the host were so kind and helpful. It felt like home! 🙂

name: Dennis
text: Nice cabin with view for a change of scenery.  Bright and clean.  Had a great time with the family. Woke up to beautiful sunrise view every morning right from the loft.

name: Gerald
text: Very nice place in a quiet neighborhood. Everything is close in Big Bear. The place felt like home.  Thank you!

name: Abel
text: Craig was a very great host! My family and I felt right at home the moment we stepped foot into the cabin, Craig was very responsive to any questions we had. we would definitely stay again.

name: Sean
text: My wife and I thoroughly enjoyed our big bear cabin getaway! The cabin had it all, flexible check-in, cozy fireplace, great balcony, and very convenient for snowboarding at bear mountain.

name: Byanka
text: Craig's cabin was a dream! If you’re looking for a cozy and quiet home that’s near fun activities but not in the center of the hustle and bustle, this is the place for you. The cabin was nice and warm when we arrived and very clear, concise instructions were in the counter. The cabin was smaller than I had picture in my brain but it did not disappoint! The loft area was one of my favorite places to be in. I read a ton in this space while on our trip. All you need is about an 8 minute drive down the mountain. We frequented Stater Bros, Vons and even Walgreens during our stay and we had no trouble getting to these spots. Even in the crisp cold weather we found some time to spend a few minutes in their decks taking in the sun and scenery. You can see one of the ski resorts from the loft deck! Overall we had a wonderful experience and we would love to come back.

name: Eric
text: Perfect experience!

name: Valissa
text: Super responsive and accommodating.

name: Katie
text: We spent our first time to Big Bear at Craig's. He was an excellent host. We had a great, cozy time and left as it began to snow. The kitchen had everything we need and was fully stocked. We appreciated the Restaurant Guide and used it a few times. The internet worked awesome with multiple phones and Kindles. We had 2 energetic boys who loved the loft. Pillows and towels were clean and as the other reviews said they definitely care about the details which made our stay very comfortable. They had a Nest and the heat worked awesome which we appreciated since we didn’t make a fire. We were a bit high maintenance and couldn’t get the Roku to work. Craig was super responsive and helpful. This place is not near restaurants but a quick drive really anywhere. Being up the hill allowed us to have a peaceful stay when we were at the cabin.

name: Harrison And Kalle
text: We really enjoyed our time at this cabin! it was very comfortable, welcoming, and well set up for our family. the moonridge neighborhood is great, and our kids had fun in the snow and with the games provided. we would happily return!

name: Jacqueline
text: Thank for hosting and trusting us with your cabin. It was very clean and cozy. The beds were super comfy. The backyard was very spacious and the kids had a lot of fun playing in the snow. We appreciate your friendliness and attentiveness.

name: Arjud
text: Craig was very welcoming and responsive. Heater throughout the whole house so we were always comfortable and cozy! The whole house was well kept, definitely recommend this place!

name: Scott
text: We had a wonderful stay and Craig was a great host. We had some extreme weather while they were there and they were proactive about sharing plowing contacts and making sure we were taken care of. Also place was very cozy with super comfortable beds and couches and a great heating system. Plus the kitchen was well equipped, bathroom was clean, extra bedding was easy to find. We'd definitely stay there again!

name: Josefina
text: We love it

name: Shirley
text: We had a great time at the cabin.  Everything was very well prepared at the house and we love the attention to details.   Would come back again when we have the chance.

name: Sonali
text: Beautiful house, very clean and smells really good. Craig is really friendly and responsive. Would definitely recommend!! 5/5

name: Elizabeth
text: An excellent place to spend a wonderful days with the family, the cabin is super clean, super great view and super comfortable, we will be back!! Thank you!!!

name: Sarah
text: Very easy check in and the cabin looks just like the pictures. Very close to the town ( 5-7 minute drive). They host respond quickly and super nice. Would totally book again.

name: Norma
text: Craig was exceptionally attentive to anything we needed.  The customer service was excellent.   It’s clearly evident that they care about providing an incredible stay for the guests.  Needless to say the cabin was wonderful and the perfect size for our family!  The kids had a great time playing with the snow outside.  The amenities were great.  Kids loved the hot cocoa.  Definitely kid friendly.  The parking area was clear of snow and ready for our arrival.  We are looking forward to going back!!  Thank you.  Have a blessed and prosperous new year.

name: Gustavo
text: What a beautiful home!! The pictures are what you’d actually expect to see! The location of this home couldn’t be any better! Beautiful surroundings! Peaceful! And if you’re looking to go snowboarding at the big bear resort it’s only down the street! Everything was perfect!

name: Laura
text: This place is more than awesome. We were amazed by how beautiful the Christmas tree was the moment we arrived. Every corner was clean and well furnished. We watched Netflix on sofa while it was snowing heavily outside (an amazing experience for someone who don’t get to see snow very often!!). The host really knows and cares about what their guests want. They even prepared ice cubes in the freezer which helped us complete our self-made drink. All in all, a wonderful place that I definitely would want to revisit!!

name: Andre
text: Peaceful and lovely place ❤️

name: Stephanie
text: Craig was extremely communicative, with very quick responses. The check-in process was easy and clear. The home is in a wonderful area, very close to the zoo and some good restaurants (note- it is not walkable to restaurants, etc. given the somewhat steep hill to drive up/down). The beds were very comfortable, the couch was amazing (and they provide couch blankets), and everything was clean. Something to consider when deciding who will sleep in which bed- the bathroom is closest to the main bedroom (loft guests walk downstairs for the bathroom). Wonderful stay, great hosts, and great furniture!

name: Vanessa
text: Great cabin, it had everything we needed. My family and I loved it! We would love to stay here again.

name: Sean
text: Very nice place. Very quiet. Was a great retreat to get away. We would definitely go back.

name: Danny
text: Great Stay!

name: Rocio
text: Place was very nice I’m  Vety pleased , it check in was very smoothly

name: Josh
text: Absolutely gorgeous cabin with all the amenities you need and then some! Excellent for a Big Bear getaway in a beautifully picturesque part of the mountain. The views were stunning and even when the temp gets close to single digits, the cabin stays warm and cozy! Perfect place to stay whether you come for outdoor mountains adventures and need a comfy cozy place to come home to; and even better if you plan on staying in the entire time. Craig is wonderful and you are in great hands during your stay. 10/10 would stay again!

name: Javier And Alejandra
text: Great place to stay and relax. Communication with Craig was perfect. We loved it!

name: Alexis
text: Amazing cozy stay, would stay again!

name: Jennie
text: Nice cozy cabin. We had a short power outage that affected the whole area. Craig reassured us power would likely return within the hour and it did! We enjoyed our stay.

name: Lauren
text: Absolutely wonderful place to stay for a fall retreat with friends! Check-in was super easy and they were readily available if I had any questions. Short drive to town and several hiking trails. We loved enjoying our morning coffee on the back deck with a great view of the trees and sunrise. So peaceful! Thank you guys for a lovely stay!

name: Jesse
text: Great place!

name: Henderson, Nevada
text: Really easy to find, great little place to stay at for awhile. Not too far from anything, while still being in a nice quiet area.

name: Max
text: What an amazing cabin, the host was super friendly and helpful, the rooms are big and air condition works perfectly, we spent most of our time at the back porch, can’t get enough of the cabin view, definitely come back soon!!!! By the way they have super fast wifi!!!

name: Jade
text: Beautiful home with equally beautiful views. I loved my stay

name: Lara
text: Your cabin is excellent! I will be recommended for all my friends!

name: Thiago
text: Great stay! Especially since the "Lakeview" options are really not worth it anymore due to the drought lake. This is the perfect place for a couple or 4 friends. Super high up in the mountain, quiet, just a perfect getaway to unplug from the big city! Craig was very attentive and super fast in responding to my requests.

name: Chris
text: Great location for all our weekend activities: Friday golf, Saturday mountain biking and Sunday kayaking. Super close to the grocery store, too! Might not sound like a big deal, but the shampoo, body wash, and TP provided was actually good quality haha so take that as you may. Great spot and can’t wait to return!

name: Sheena
text: We had a great stay at the cabin. It is located in a convenient location close the village, restaurants, lake and trials. You still require a car to come down the hill but proximity to all attractions was great. We had all the amenities we needed. It’s a great cabin for a staycation or a day out.

name: Eric
text: Great place, great host, would recommend!

name: Hua
text: We really like the coziness Craig & Mercede’s Cabin provided. It got nice deco all throughout. We particularly appreciate the bird watching experience on the deck!

name: Paula
text: I absolutely loved this cabin. It was so beautiful and peaceful. Everything was so organized, I love how the kitchen had labels, it was nice not being able to have to look for things. Such a nice gesture you guys labeled everything so people don’t have to look around. The check in was so easy. The only thing was it was kind of hot inside the house. Maybe a portable AC would be nice, that was honestly the only bad of the trip. If you sleep in the top bedroom be prepared to wake up at 5 am, the sun hits you which woke up my one year old, but the view was so incredible, I loved looking at the sun rise while in bed. It was so beautiful. Overall I would love to come again, highly recommend. Plus the view …. Wow , you can’t beat that, and the quietness.

name: Irina
text: The cabin was really cozy and the back porch just made us so relaxed..Just imagine the birds tweeting, the cool breeze of the fresh air while you sit down and relax. We all stayed at the loft area in the second floor where it has two beds and a sofa. The view of the sunrise from the glass windows when you’re at the loft is just stunning. The cabin was so clean and equipped with everything that you need especially in the kitchen. We totally recommend this place and would surely go back when visiting Big bear.

name: Lucia
text: Amazing view , quiet and amazing. The host is very attentive and helpful. All instructions and suggestions are provided for you. Loved it

name: Lorenzo
text: This house is nice and accommodating comfortable clean I would definitely be coming back to this place to make more memories.

name: Kai
text: Craig was a great host! Very pretty deck that was nice to watch the sunrise and sunset with some coffee! Craig provides many fans for the cabin but it can still be quite hot in the summer without A/C, so keep that in mind if you you are traveling with very old or very young people. Overall amazing experience! 5/5

name: Andrew
text: Stayed at this lovely cabin for 3 nights in the summer and loved our stay. Had all the amenities we needed and really enjoyed the view from the deck as you can see from the photos. The hosts were super nice and very responsive. Would definitely stay again if given the opportunity. Thanks Craig!

name: Richard
text: We really enjoyed staying at the cabin over the July 4th weekend. I wanted something that felt very private, in the woods, and have a fantastic view of nature and we got just that. They were very kind to have left a welcome binder for us to read through that had information on how to check in and check out that helped make it very clear how we could use anything around the house. The spacious cabin could comfortable fit 6 people with it’s multiple beds and the glass frame on the backend near the ceiling is beautiful and gives the cabin a very open feel. The kitchen was fully stocked with coffee essentials. My guest, a coffee lover, was very happy with that. The porch has an incredible view of the landscape which made us feel like we were almost camping! We were concerned about it being too hot during the night – since my guest and I have never stayed in big bear and are sensitive to heat. So, we opened the windows during the day and night which cooled the place down. All in all, we really enjoyed our stay here and are already planning on making a return soon. Thank you for having us and sharing your space with us.

name: Elena
text: We are a family of six and we had enough space for all. It is a very cozy cabin. Our kids loved having their own space in the loft. Only thing they complained about was the sunlight in their face, that was coming through the large window, waking them up really early in the morning. I, on the other hand, enjoyed watching the sunrise while still tucked in bed. We loved spending time out on the deck in the evenings, just hanging out or having dinner. We got groceries at Vons, which is pretty close. We had our own parking and that made it easy for loading and unloading. The zoo is about 6 minutes away. Some of the best hiking trails are about 8 or 9 minutes away.

name: Devin
text: The view from this house is heavenly. Have to stay here again during the winter season. Absolutely stunning.

name: Boyu
text: Great experience!

name: Carly
text: Lovely place to stay.  I appreciated the fast responses to questions and checking in was easy.

name: Raphael
text: Great place to stay. The balcony had an amazing view. Drinking coffee in the morning while enjoying the sun and the trees around was great. Great communication with Craig.

name: Dallas, Texas
text: This is a lovely cabin. It’s nice and bright and the neighborhood is really quiet. The deck view is even more amazing at night!

name: Mikael
text: Tranquil. The nature surrounding the cabin is so peaceful in the morning.

name: Hemet, California
text: My wife and I planned a Big Bear getaway for our 5 year anniversary and we couldn’t have picked a better location! This place was close to so many places and we got to do a lot during our stay! Our 2 year old also had a blast. We took her to the Alpine zoo and a little park over by Big Bear Lake. The cabin definitely exceeded our expectations and we would be glad to stay here again! Thank you Craig for making our stay here memorable and enjoyable!

name: Danny
text: Very cozy and great location. Will be back !

name: Jessika
text: Thank you! Absolutely loved and enjoyed our stay! Place was very clean and very cozy. Look forward to booking with you again

name: Amy
text: Bear View Cove exceeded all of our expectations, including high quality amenities, luxurious bedding, and a clean, well maintained space. Craig was a gracious host who responded promptly to all of our questions. We will absolutely be staying here again in the future.

name: Duane
text: We had a great time, very clean, and about a 10 minute drive to the heart of Big Bear.

name: Kristelle
text: Small cabin with all-inclusive, very clean, very nice, you really don't need or take shampoo, you will feel in a hotel. I definitely recommend it. and best of all, Craig was always on the lookout. thank you so much for everything!

name: Nicolae
text: Good location, quiet and peaceful. Back patio is great. The property is clean and equipped with everything the travelers need. Easy communication with host. Overall very positive experience!

name: Megan
text: What a lovely bright open cabin!  It was in the perfect location, close to everything we wanted to do!  Loved all the amenities and board games too.  Our kids LOVED the loft!

name: David
text: Craig was a great host! Responded very quickly, and was very accommodating to our needs/requests. Check-in instructions were super detailed and helpful. The cabin  was very clean and well stocked. We could not have asked for a better location. Overall a wonderful place; we would stay here again easily!

name: Shell
text: This was a great cabin to stay out for our short few days. It was close to the city and skiiing. I would stay here again.

name: Brandi
text: This place was great. The home was nice and cozy and bright. It was a last minute weekend getaway for me and I had no issues booking or checking in. Loved it and would return!

name: Rodney
text: The cabin was so nice and clean,kitchen was well stock with cooking essentials. Very roomy for the whole family. Great location and close to the ski resort ,host was extremely communicative. Definitely be back soon.

name: Rachel
text: Loved it!  Great location. Close to everything, but far enough to enjoy the quiet nights and relaxing mornings. You really don’t need to pack much, they are very considerate on supplying you with daily necessities. Beds are also very comfortable and the cabin heats up really fast, especially with fireplace on. Craig is very friendly and a great communicator. Highly recommend staying here. Thank you for a great getaway. Will come back again.

name: Raymond
text: Great host! Very clean home and easy communication. The host was very concern with making us feel at home and we’re there to answer any questions we may have. Definitely would recommend to family and friends!

name: Nikki
text: Beautiful cozy place with amazing view of trees and mountain. Everything was so clean and welcoming, check in and out process was seamless, and the hosts were phenomenal and very responsive. Looking forward to coming back

name: Lai Ah Che
text: My family loved the place, the house, the view! The host makes sure everything’s alright and responds quickly for everything. We would love to stay there again.

name: Ayodeji
text: We love this and wi definitely use it again! Thank you Craig for having us!

name: Priscilla
text: The house was cute and cozy. We planned a long weekend trip for my daughter’s 5th birthday. She had been asking for the snow. The home was close to everything - tubing/skiing, grocery store, the village and places to eat. Craig communicated well and made sure we had everything we needed prior and during our trip.

name: Juan
text: Good place, very close to everything you would want to do. No on site trash can is pretty inconvient, having to drive down into town to dispose of your trash sucks.

name: Patricia
text: the cabin was comfortable and perfect for a family of 4.

name: Esteban
text: Overall space was clean but smaller than expected

name: Shirley
text: The cabin was wonderful, however with the excessive heat while we were there, it was uncomfortably hot for a large part of the day.

name: Elijah
text: My wife and I wanted to get away for a couple of days from the Arizona heat and decided Big Bear Lake was a great place to go so we looked and booked this little cabin in the mountains. I want to start by saying we would absolutely book this cabin again as it was the perfect size for our family of 4 (2 under 2) and the hosts were very friendly, responsive, and helpful. The only downsides we had with our stay was the heat was a little more than we expected. Now this is of no fault to the hosts and we knew upon booking that because of the cathedral window the sun would be let in however, as soon as the sun rose the cabin would instantly heat up. The average temperature inside during the day was between 85-90 degrees even with all the windows open and fans running. The only other issue we had was the amount of dust that was caked onto the fans and would blow into the cabin when on, which was often. This is definitely place to come during cold months and we would love to experience that.

name: Nathalie
text: We stayed at this beautiful rural cabin for three nights and loved our time there. The drive in was scenic and peaceful, and the area is incredibly quiet—perfect for a relaxing escape. It got a little warm during the day, but the fans kept the space comfortable. At night, the cool, fresh air made it a great place to unwind. One small downside: the pillows were either too flat or too soft, which made sleep a bit tricky—bring your own if you’re particular. Also, since it was our first time at higher altitude, we experienced mild headaches, so packing Advil or similar might help. Overall, a peaceful, nature-filled retreat we’d absolutely recommend. 🌲✨

name: Ethan
text: Great place, drive is a little twisty but its big bear. I wish the curtains in the loft were in better shape.

name: Trinidad
text: Hosts were great! There were a few bumps in the road but nothing they could control, like the road being blocked off due to cars not being able to get up the hill and the driveway being full of snow so it made it a little hard to locate. When we reached out they were super responsive! Other than this the location is close to everything, the house is nice and cozy with a great kitchen and living room.

name: Alicia
text: Thank you for providing us with an amazing cabin to create fond memories with our loved ones! Thank you for also being so quick to respond to all of our last minute inquiries.

name: Kelli
text: My husband and I booked a 4 day Big Bear trip to celebrate our birthdays.  The home and location were beautiful. Craig was an excellent host and very responsive. We will be back for a winter trip!

name: Alberto
text: So easy and convenient to book.Such a lovely stay!

name: Cirila
text: Nice and peaceful

name: Adriana
text: Beautiful cabin with lovely host who respond fast. Would recommend!

name: Dzhamilia
text: The hosts are very responsive and nice . There was trash left before our check-in and the host was able to pick it up within 30-40 mins. They seemed caring and asked if anything else was needed. The place overall is ok, but tiny. May be a good one for 2 and in winter time when you can ignite the fireplace. It’s cosy but at the same time the bathroom is super tiny and only one. There are washer and drier in the bedroom , which is odd and you need to utilize it before you go to bed . Also the heater started working loudly at night making very weird burnt smell may be because it’s old . The living room is tiny as well. We didn’t stay for another night and left earlier . There is a spring board and mattress at the loft area when I sat on it (looked like a bed ) it was very unstable and you can easily fell off.

name: Eleazar
text: The place was great, a little tricky to navigate all the roads but its gets easier after the first time. The cabin itself was cozy and spacious, my family and I felt right at home. The only thing that was a little frustrating was throwing out our trash after check-out. We were given a specific address but once we got there we were told we had to go somewhere else 8 miles away that was closed on Sundays! (day of check-out) Plus, on the original description there was NO mention of a $25 fee for not throwing our trash until the day of. I don’t think the guest should have to throw out their own trash especially if the facility is so far away. Overall we had a peaceful time during our stay, just wish we didn’t have to deal with the last part.

name: Denny
text: Lovely home, with the exception of the fridge having a bad smell and the grill not working. Other than that we had a great time there. Thanks for your hospitality.

name: Tyler
text: Good

name: Aileen
text: The cabin is nice with a very nice deck. Quiet area. Craig was very responsive. We enjoyed our stay.

name: Sarah
text: Cute cabin! Quiet location with privacy. The host was very responsive. The only downside was a few dirty pans and a bit of trash in the cabin. The hosts communication was great!

name: Jorge
text: Great cabin! Went out there on a guys trip It was 3 of us and we all enjoyed it. Pros: -good tv and wifi -beds are comfortable and clean -they have a grill for some barbecue -fire place was a plus -super friendly host and very responsive -everything was about a 10min drive away Cons: -the couch was kind of small for 3 people if you want to lay down to watch a movie - if you need anything from the store you do have to keep driving up and down the neighborhood

name: Genesis
text: Had a wonderful Christmas 🎄 here

name: Mukhalad
text: Nice place, quiet neighborhood,  Craig is very responsive, on the other hand the sun will wake you up very early 😀 .

name: Rana
text: Such a cute and cozy home. Perfect for a family trip. Very clean and close to the slopes!

name: Henry
text: Nice place but ants (living room ) mostly & spiders would randomly pop out of nowhere. Beautiful view looking out but the minute I look up there was spider webs & dust like if it wasn’t touched. 5/10 stay

name: Karim
text: Nice neighborhood, unfortunately the stay was a little disappointing. Fireplace wasn’t cleaned and all the lighters empty, TV was difficult to work as we had to use the actual tv to change settings every time we turned it on. It just didn’t seem like anyone had been in there for a while to make sure things were up to standard. Has beautiful view and potential to be a great spot.
